entry.title: Resolution 548 (2024-2026) (Hawaiʻi County): — → Adopted
entry.content:
AWARDS FIVE STEWARDSHIP GRANTS FROM THE PUBLIC ACCESS, OPEN SPACE, AND NATURAL RESOURCES PRESERVATION MAINTENANCE FUND AS RECOMMENDED BY THE DIRECTOR OF FINANCE FOR THE FISCAL YEAR ENDING JUNE 30, 2027

Authorizes the Director of Finance to provide Public Access, Open Space, and Natural Resources Preservation Maintenance Fund Stewardship grants totaling $477,266.50 to four nonprofit organizations, pursuant to Section 10-16(h) of the Hawaiʻi County Charter.

Status: — → Adopted

Latest action: Council: Adopts Res. 548-26 & FC-147 - 05/20/26
